title: OmniMatchDeeplearningTool
summary: A pure C++23 deep learning engine and Qt6 GUI for computer vision tasks (MLP, ResNet, U-Net, ViT, GAN, anomaly detection) built without Python or PyTorch/TensorFlow. The only match to SDV patterns is the string 'ctest', an unrelated C++ testing command, with no genuine SDV connection.
evidence: pattern hit 'ct' matches 'ctest --output-on-failure' in README testing section, unrelated to CTGAN
